text:
alex: FYI discovered recurring peering failures impacting dedicated customers after a small routing tweak. grouping looks like 4 customers this month.
jamal: can you list the symptoms and likely triggers?
alex: symptoms: increased request tail latency for emb endpoints, intermittent GRPC resets, selective tenant isolation. trigger seems to be asymmetric TCP windowing when an onprem NAT plus firewall reorder packets.
maria: this mirrors some previous isolation bugs but not identical. have we correlated with config pushes?
alex: yes 1/04 push to edge-configs coincides with first sign. ops-bot: alert: peering-flap-detector fired 2023-04-21T03:12Z for node-group-dedicated-7 (alert id: pf-7812).
jamal: propose action items: short fix (per-tenant retry backoff + lower cache TTL) owner: jamal ETA: 36h (ticket INF-3001). medium: runbook update + test harness owner: maria ETA: 5d (ticket RB-150). long: deploy peering-cohort detector (PD-88) owner: alex ETA: 3w.
maria: I'll include an onprem verification checklist (port ranges, NAT timeouts, firewall sequence guarantees) and add a small test case. sample: ```bash
# from customer-side test host
seq=1; while [ $seq -le 30 ]; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "X-Test-Seq: $seq" https://edge.internal/health || echo "fail $seq"; seq=$((seq+1)); sleep 0.5; done
```
jamal: good. also capture KMS/HSM latency metrics 1 we saw spikes correlating with cust-D.
ops-bot: note: scheduled maintenance window requested by cust-B for 2023-04-29 02:00-04:00 UTC.
alex: INF-3001 will include a canary pipeline and a fast rollback hook. I'll add a small telemetry tag in the runtime to mark peering-session-id and customer-tag.
maria: add vendor compatibility table to RB-150: Fortinet, PaloAlto, Juniper, Cisco ASA, vendor-internal. ops-bot: support ticket list attached: SUP-9012, SUP-9025.
jamal: blockers: need logs from onprem firewall for cust-C 1 support to get that.access. maria can you escalate?
maria: escalating now. will also collect tcpdump snippets and share a short packet reordering example.
alex: I'll draft the postmortem follow-up doc and include a "cohort regression" section with signals and thresholds. will tag customers for communication review.
jamal: let's agree on checkpoints: daily slack updates until INF-3001 lands, weekly for PD-88.
maria: I'll open RB-150 PR as WIP by EOD and include rollback steps and a minimal smoke test.
ops-bot: reminder: incident follow-up sync in #incidents in 18h.
alex: marking statuses: INF-3001 (open), RB-150 (wip), PD-88 (proposal).
jamal: thanks. treat this as a recurring template: detect cohorts, isolate tenant routing, run fast canary, notify customers. :thumbsup:
maria: agree. will compile the short follow-up report by Friday with owners, tickets, and windows.
alex: linking draft runbook: https://git.redwood.local/runbooks/peering-cohort-detection/pull/5 (draft).
ops-bot: logged: follow-up-check 2245678901 created.
jamal: closing for now, next check-in tomorrow morning.
